result:
T-DG1-FE is finished. The acceptance checks pass, and all 16 browser journeys pass in English and Arabic against the real API and a throwaway PostgreSQL database. My handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/T-DG1-FE-frontend-ux-engineer.md`. The changes are uncommitted, only touch `apps/web/**` and `packages/design-tokens/**`, and add no dependencies. The seven seeded token values are byte-identical.

**What's built**
- **Shell:** Arabic right-to-left by default, with a language switch to English. The switch updates `lang`/`dir` on `<html>` and is saved to the user's profile, so it survives a reload. CSS uses logical properties only, and a test enforces that.
- **Navigation:** all 14 areas. The 12 that aren't built yet are labelled "Planned" and list what they will contain. Administration is hidden from users without admin roles.
- **Branding:** a text wordmark with a visible Provisional / مؤقت badge, and no logo image. Colours come from the one token source.
- **Contrast:** 50 colour pairs are checked. White text on `#0078FF` is only 4.09:1, so buttons use a derived darker blue, `#006DE9` (4.81:1). Status colours are separate from brand blue, never blue for "good", and always come with an icon and a label.
- **Fonts:** IBM Plex Sans Arabic and IBM Plex Sans are bundled locally, with no CDN.
- **Screens:**
  - sign-in;
  - transformations list with sorting, filters, paging and column selection;
  - create with mode and entry phase;
  - a detail workspace that shows "Unknown" for data from later stages;
  - edit with conflict handling;
  - archive with a mandatory reason;
  - admin screens for organizations, business units, users and role assignments.
- **States:** empty, loading, error, stale, conflict and no-permission are all explicit.

**Checks run** (all exit 0):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` | clean |
| `pnpm --filter @mth/web test` | 66 tests passed |
| `pnpm test` (root) | 126 tests passed |
| `check:contrast` | 50 pairs meet WCAG AA; 3 known-failing pairs fail as documented |
| `check:no-cdn` | passes; a planted Google Fonts import makes it fail as expected |
| Browser journeys (`pnpm --filter @mth/web e2e`) | 16 passed |

The journeys cover sign-in, both languages, create, list, a real version-conflict and re-apply, archive, the admin screens and a user with no roles. axe found no accessibility violations at any level across 26 scans. There were no requests to other hosts and no security-policy errors.

**Bug the tests caught:** re-applying an edit after a version conflict originally re-sent every field, which would have silently undone the other user's change. It now sends only the fields this user changed, and the browser test confirms both changes survive.

**Screenshots** (17 per language, plus axe summaries) are in `apps/web/e2e/screenshots/{en,ar}/`. I couldn't put them under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/**` because that path is closed to implementers.

**Things you need to know**
- **Sign-in contract gap:** the assignment says to show the dev-login form "only when `/me.authMode = dev`", but `/me` needs a session, so the sign-in page can't read it. The page instead sends an empty dev-login request: dev mode answers 400 and every other mode answers 404. It signs nobody in, but uses one auth rate-limit slot per page load. I've asked for a public `GET /api/v1/auth/options` so this can become a one-line change.
- **Owner names:** most business users can't read user records, so sponsor and lead show "Not visible to you", and the pickers only offer "Me". I've suggested a scoped name lookup for P2.
- **Arabic text:** all Arabic strings are my own translations and need review by a native speaker.
- **Not done:**
  - a stale-data scenario in the browser (component tests cover it);
  - a full keyboard-only walkthrough (only the skip link is tested in the browser);
  - a visual review at 1440 px or on tablet/mobile (screenshots are 1280 px only);
  - sign-in through Keycloak (not available offline).
- **Environment and timing:** browser tests ran on PostgreSQL 16, not 18. I ran the DG0 historical validator (PASS) after I had started implementing, not before.
- **Housekeeping:**
  - `@hookform/resolvers` is declared but now unused and could be dropped.
  - Empty `.claude/` folders were created by the sandbox in a few package directories. They're untracked and protected, so I left them.
